title: SFO–Vancouver: document curveballs
notice: Source-reviewed against Canadian government publications on 2026-10-26. Passenger and document data are fictional; no independent human review is claimed.
tutorial: A more demanding desk: distinguish identity, status and Canadian permission. Check document categories, dates, holder names and exceptions.
